concepts.name: a tumbling window on the coordinated universal time grain
concepts.slide: Definition — a tumbling window on the coordinated universal time grain
concepts.formula: w_j = [t_0 + j·Δ, t_0 + (j+1)·Δ), Δ = 5 s, t_0 = 00:00:00 in coordinated universal time, from utc_time

concepts.name: the conservation ledger
concepts.formula: used + dropped = received, with Σ_reason drop_reasons[reason] = dropped

concepts.name: the upstream profile, and checking a frame against it
concepts.slide: Definition — the upstream profile, and checking a frame against it
concepts.formula: breaches(X, P) = the complaints P makes about X, over presence, type, range, tolerated absence and sampling step, in that order; X arrives fit for use exactly when breaches(X, P) is empty

concepts.name: Simpson's paradox
concepts.formula: P(Y|D=1) > P(Y|D=0) while P(Y|D=1,G=g) < P(Y|D=0,G=g) for every group g

concepts.name: the three missing-data mechanisms
concepts.formula: MCAR: P(M | Y_obs, Y_mis) = P(M); MAR: P(M | Y_obs, Y_mis) = P(M | Y_obs); MNAR: neither

concepts.name: the absence mask, over both encodings
concepts.slide: Definition — the absence mask and the masked exponential moving average
concepts.formula: m_t = 1 when rssi_t is null or prox_t = −1, else 0

concepts.name: the masked exponential moving average
concepts.slide: Definition — the absence mask and the masked exponential moving average
concepts.formula: s_t = α·x_t + (1−α)·s_{t−1} over the heard readings only, α = 0.3, carried forward across a gap

concepts.name: imputation bias
concepts.formula: bias = (1/|F|) Σ_{t ∈ F} (fill_t − truth_t), F the rows the method filled, in decibels

concepts.name: a fitted transform
concepts.slide: Definition — the fitted transform, and applying it
concepts.formula: θ = fit(X_train) = (median_j, μ_j, σ_j, column order), σ_j = √( (1/n) Σ_i (x_ij − μ_j)² ), ddof = 0

concepts.name: applying a fitted transform
concepts.slide: Definition — the fitted transform, and applying it
concepts.formula: apply(X, θ)_ij = (fill(x_ij, median_j) − μ_j) / σ_j, columns in the stored order

concepts.name: target leakage, and the ninety-nine per cent rule
concepts.slide: Definition — target leakage, and the rule that catches it here
concepts.formula: column c leaks when agreement(c) ≥ 0.99, or purity(c) ≥ 0.99 with |values(c)| ≤ 10, where agreement(c) = max( mean(1[c present] = 1[Y = IN]), mean(1[c present] ≠ 1[Y = IN]) ) and purity(c) = Σ_v max_y n(v, y) / n

concepts.name: the verdict on a candidate feature
concepts.slide: Definition — the verdict on a candidate feature
concepts.formula: verdict: E → {keep, keep with the mask, drop}, a total function of the six measured quantities alone, with reason ⊆ E: every number in the reason is a value in E

concepts.name: the six window features
concepts.formula: over the last w readings: x̄, σ with ddof = 0, min, max, slope b = Σ_i (i − ī)(x_i − x̄) / Σ_i (i − ī)², and r_1

concepts.name: a split by time
concepts.slide: Definition — a split by time, never at random
concepts.formula: train = {x_t : t < t_c}, test = {x_t : t ≥ t_c} for one cut instant t_c, the ⌊f·n⌋-th time in sorted order — never a random permutation of the rows

concepts.name: a nearest match within a tolerance
concepts.slide: Definition — a nearest match within a tolerance
concepts.formula: match(p) = argmin_b |t_b − t_p| when min_b |t_b − t_p| ≤ τ, else none; matched share = |{p : match(p) exists}| / n_p

concepts.name: the hand-off table and its manifest
concepts.slide: Definition — the table this module hands to the next three
concepts.formula: one row per (phone_id, window); mask_c = 1[x_c absent] beside x_c for every filled column c and for no other; split_point t_c = the window of the ⌊f·n⌋-th row in time order, train = {t < t_c}, test = {t ≥ t_c}; θ and the ledger stored unchanged
